neighbours.label: release-order modifier of a music release: 'lead' / 'first' / 'new' before single, album or concert (lead single, first single, nuevo disco)
fire: After months of teasing, the rapper finally dropped the lead single from his upcoming record.
Critics agreed that the band's lead single was the weakest song on the whole album.
Twenty years ago she recorded her first single in a tiny studio in Memphis.
The label announced that the group's new album will arrive in stores next spring.
Fans lined up for hours to hear the duo's debut single played live for the first time.
Producers chose a slow ballad as the lead track for the soundtrack release.
Their first EP sold only a few hundred copies, mostly at local shows.
Last week the singer premiered the lead single of her third studio album on the radio.
quiet: After months of rehearsal, the rapper finally played a show in his hometown arena.
Critics agreed that the band's drummer was the strongest musician on the whole tour.
Twenty years ago she worked as a waitress in a tiny diner in Memphis.
The label announced that the group's manager will retire from the business next spring.
Fans lined up for hours to buy tickets for the duo's concert in the park.
Producers chose a quiet hotel as the base for the soundtrack recording sessions.
Their tour van broke down twice, mostly on the way to local shows.
Last week the singer talked about her childhood and her family on the radio.
